SELECT t.id, t.sample_id AS sampleId, t.sample_no AS sampleNo, t.observation_year AS observationYear, t.due_date AS observationDueDate, t.completed, t.observation_result AS observationResult, t.observation_remark AS observationRemark, t.observer_id AS observerId, t.observation_time AS observationTime, io.batch_no AS batchNo, m.name AS materialName, m.code AS materialCode, m.specification AS materialSpec, s.current_quantity AS quantity, s.unit_id AS unitId, s.receive_time AS retentionTime, s.receiver_id AS retentionUserId, s.retention_expiry_date AS retentionExpiryDate, s.storage_location AS storageLocation, -- 判断是否临期（7天内到期） CASE WHEN t.due_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isUpcoming, -- 计算距离到期天数 DATEDIFF(t.due_date, CURDATE()) AS daysUntilDue FROM lm_retention_observation_task t INNER JOIN lm_sample s ON t.sample_id = s.id LEFT JOIN lm_inspection_order io ON s.inspection_order_id = io.id LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_material m ON io.material_id = m.id WHERE t.is_deleted = 0 AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.discarded = 0 AND t.completed = 0
AND m.id IN
#{materialId}
AND io.batch_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.batchNo}, '%')
AND t.sample_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.sampleNo}, '%')
AND t.due_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ORDER BY t.due_date ASC, t.sample_no ASC
ORDER BY t.due_date ASC, t.sample_no ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lm_retention_observation_task t INNER JOIN lm_sample s ON t.sample_id = s.id WHERE t.is_deleted = 0 AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.discarded = 0 AND s.destroyed = 0 AND t.completed = 0 AND t.due_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
